description: Unclaimed ETH dividends in the AimBot dividend tracker

meta.stranded_reason: Dividends accrued to 0x…dEaD on AIMBOT tokens burned there. The tracker has no owner-callable sweep reachable from the token contract, so this ETH is permanently immobile.
meta.claim_note: Users call claim() on the AimBot token; the token forwards to AimBotDividends.claim(msg.sender), which is onlyOwner and owned by the token. Holding AIMBOT is not required — accumulated dividends survive selling.
